1
Samuel awoɔ
1 # 1 Be 6.26-27 Na Efratini barima bi wɔ hɔ a ɔfiri Ramataim-sofim, Efraim bepɔ soɔ a ne din de Elkana, Suf ba, Tohu ba, Elihu ba, Yeroham ba. 2#Gye 29.31 Na ɔwɔ yerenom baanu, ɔbaako din de Hana, na ɔbaako din de Penina. Na Penina wɔ mma, nanso Hana deɛ, na ɔnni ba.
3Daa afe ɔbarima yi firi ne kurom kɔ sɛ ɔrekɔsɔre na wabɔ afɔdeɛ ama asafo AWURADE wɔ Silo. Na ɛhɔ na Eli mma baanu Hofni ne Pinehas di AWURADE asɔfoɔ. 4Na da a Elkana bɔ afɔdeɛ no, ɔma ne yere Penina ne ne mmammarima ne ne mmammaa nyinaa kyɛfa. 5Na Hana deɛ, ɔma no baanu kyɛfa, ɛfiri sɛ ɔdɔ Hana, nanso AWURADE ato ne yafunu mu. 6Na ahi ara na na ne kora no yi no sɛ ɔbɛhuru ne boɔ, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE ato ne yafunu mu. 7Na saa na na ɔyɛ afe biara. Daa sɛ wɔforo kɔ AWURADE fie a, ɔyi no ahi saa; na ɔsu na ɔnnidi. 8Na ne kunu Elkana ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hana, adɛn na wosu, na adɛn na wonnidie, na adɛn na wo bo nnwoɔ? Menyɛ memma wo nsene mmammarima du anaa?
9Na wɔdidiiɛ na wɔnom wieeɛ wɔ Silo no, Hana sɔreeɛ; nanso na Ɔsɔfoɔ Eli te adwa so AWURADE asɔredan ano aponnwa ho. 10Na ne kra werɛ hoe, na ɔbɔɔ AWURADE mpaeɛ, na ɔde yea sui. 11#Num 6.2-21 Na ɔhyɛɛ bɔ sɛ: Asafo AWURADE, sɛ wohwɛ w’afenaa amanehunu na wokae me, na wo werɛ amfiri w’afenaa, na woma w’afenaa ɔbabanin a, ɛnneɛ mede no bɛma AWURADE ne nkwa nna nyinaa, na oyiwan biara renka ne ti.
12Na ɛbaa sɛ, ɔgu so rebɔ mpaeɛ AWURADE anim no, Eli hwɛɛ n’ano dinn; 13na Hana rekasa n’akoma mu, na n’ano nko na ɔbesebese, na ne nne deɛ, wɔnte. Enti Eli buu no sɛ ɔsabofoɔ. 14Ɛnna Eli ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Da bɛn na wobɛboro nsa akɔsie? Yi wo nsanom firi w’ani so. 15#Dwom 62.8 Na Hana buaa sɛ: Dabi, me wura, meyɛ ɔbaa werɛhoni; na bobesa ne nsa biara deɛ, mennom bi, na mahwie me kra magu AWURADE anim; 16mfa w’abaawa nto ɔbaa huhuni bi ho, ɛfiri sɛ m’awerɛhoɔ ne m’ayamgya dodoɔ mu na makasa abɛsi sɛsɛɛ yi. 17Ɛnna Eli buaa sɛ: Fa asomdwoeɛ kɔ, na Israel Nyankopɔn mma wo adeɛ a wosrɛɛ no ne hɔ no. 18Na ɔkaa sɛ: Ma w’afenaa nnya w’anim adom. Ɛnna ɔbaa no sii mu kɔ kɔdidiiɛ, na n’anim nte sɛ kane no bio.
19 # Gye 30.22 Na wɔsɔree anɔpatutu kɔsɔree AWURADE anim, na wɔsane baa wɔn fie Rama. Na Elkana ne ne yere Hana daeɛ, na AWURADE kaee no; 20na afe reduro no, na Hana anyinsɛn awo ɔbabarima, na ɔtoo no din Samuel,#1.20 SAMUEL: Asekyerɛ ne: Onyankopɔn ate. na ɔkaa sɛ: AWURADE hɔ na mesrɛɛ no.
21Na ɔbarima Elkana ne ne fiefoɔ nyinaa foro kɔɔ sɛ ɔrekɔbɔ afirinhyia afɔdeɛ de n’aboadeɛ akɔma AWURADE. 22Na Hana deɛ, wankɔ, na ɔka kyerɛɛ ne kunu sɛ: Gye sɛ abɔfra no atwa nufoɔ ansa na mede no akɔ, na wakɔpue AWURADE anim, na watena hɔ daa. 23Na ne kunu Elkana ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Yɛ deɛ ɛyɛ wɔ w’ani so, tena hɔ kɔsi sɛ wobɛtwa no nufoɔ ansa; AWURADE asɛm ara na ɔmma no nnyina. Na ɔbaa no tenaa hɔ maa ne ba nufoɔ de kɔsii sɛ ɔtwaa no. 24Na ɔtwaa no no, ɔfaa no kaa ne ho de nantwinini a wadi mfeɛ mmiɛnsa ne esiam efa baako ne bobesa kotokuo ma de no baa AWURADE fie Silo. Na abɔfra no sua. 25Na wɔkum nantwinini no, na wɔde abɔfra no brɛɛ Eli. 26Na ɔkaa sɛ: O me wura, sɛ wo kra te aseɛ yi, me wura, mene ɔbaa a ɔbɛgyinaa wo nkyɛn ha yi bɔɔ AWURADE mpaeɛ no. 27#1 Sa 1.17 Abɔfra yi ho mpaeɛ na mebɔeɛ, na AWURADE ama me adeɛ a mesrɛɛ no ne hɔ no. 28#1 Sa 1.11 Enti me deɛ, mede no mafɛm AWURADE; ne nna a ɔbɛtena aseɛ nyinaa mede no mama AWURADE. Na ɔsɔree AWURADE wɔ hɔ.

Na Efratini barima bi wɔ hɔ a ɔfiri Ramataim-sofim, Efraim bepɔ soɔ a ne din de Elkana, Suf ba, Tohu ba, Elihu ba, Yeroham ba. Na ɔwɔ yerenom baanu, ɔbaako din de Hana, na ɔbaako din de Penina. Na Penina wɔ mma, nanso Hana deɛ, na ɔnni ba.
Daa afe ɔbarima yi firi ne kurom kɔ sɛ ɔrekɔsɔre na wabɔ afɔdeɛ ama asafo AWURADE wɔ Silo. Na ɛhɔ na Eli mma baanu Hofni ne Pinehas di AWURADE asɔfoɔ. Na da a Elkana bɔ afɔdeɛ no, ɔma ne yere Penina ne ne mmammarima ne ne mmammaa nyinaa kyɛfa. Na Hana deɛ, ɔma no baanu kyɛfa, ɛfiri sɛ ɔdɔ Hana, nanso AWURADE ato ne yafunu mu. Na ahi ara na na ne kora no yi no sɛ ɔbɛhuru ne boɔ, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE ato ne yafunu mu. Na saa na na ɔyɛ afe biara. Daa sɛ wɔforo kɔ AWURADE fie a, ɔyi no ahi saa; na ɔsu na ɔnnidi. Na ne kunu Elkana ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hana, adɛn na wosu, na adɛn na wonnidie, na adɛn na wo bo nnwoɔ? Menyɛ memma wo nsene mmammarima du anaa?

Na ɔhyɛɛ bɔ sɛ: Asafo AWURADE, sɛ wohwɛ w’afenaa amanehunu na wokae me, na wo werɛ amfiri w’afenaa, na woma w’afenaa ɔbabanin a, ɛnneɛ mede no bɛma AWURADE ne nkwa nna nyinaa, na oyiwan biara renka ne ti.

Ɛnna Eli ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Da bɛn na wobɛboro nsa akɔsie? Yi wo nsanom firi w’ani so. Na Hana buaa sɛ: Dabi, me wura, meyɛ ɔbaa werɛhoni; na bobesa ne nsa biara deɛ, mennom bi, na mahwie me kra magu AWURADE anim; mfa w’abaawa nto ɔbaa huhuni bi ho, ɛfiri sɛ m’awerɛhoɔ ne m’ayamgya dodoɔ mu na makasa abɛsi sɛsɛɛ yi. Ɛnna Eli buaa sɛ: Fa asomdwoeɛ kɔ, na Israel Nyankopɔn mma wo adeɛ a wosrɛɛ no ne hɔ no. Na ɔkaa sɛ: Ma w’afenaa nnya w’anim adom. Ɛnna ɔbaa no sii mu kɔ kɔdidiiɛ, na n’anim nte sɛ kane no bio.
Na wɔsɔree anɔpatutu kɔsɔree AWURADE anim, na wɔsane baa wɔn fie Rama. Na Elkana ne ne yere Hana daeɛ, na AWURADE kaee no; na afe reduro no, na Hana anyinsɛn awo ɔbabarima, na ɔtoo no din Samuel, na ɔkaa sɛ: AWURADE hɔ na mesrɛɛ no.
Na ɔbarima Elkana ne ne fiefoɔ nyinaa foro kɔɔ sɛ ɔrekɔbɔ afirinhyia afɔdeɛ de n’aboadeɛ akɔma AWURADE. Na Hana deɛ, wankɔ, na ɔka kyerɛɛ ne kunu sɛ: Gye sɛ abɔfra no atwa nufoɔ ansa na mede no akɔ, na wakɔpue AWURADE anim, na watena hɔ daa. Na ɔtwaa no no, ɔfaa no kaa ne ho de nantwinini a wadi mfeɛ mmiɛnsa ne esiam efa baako ne bobesa kotokuo ma de no baa AWURADE fie Silo. Na abɔfra no sua. Na wɔkum nantwinini no, na wɔde abɔfra no brɛɛ Eli. Na ɔkaa sɛ: O me wura, sɛ wo kra te aseɛ yi, me wura, mene ɔbaa a ɔbɛgyinaa wo nkyɛn ha yi bɔɔ AWURADE mpaeɛ no. Abɔfra yi ho mpaeɛ na mebɔeɛ, na AWURADE ama me adeɛ a mesrɛɛ no ne hɔ no. Enti me deɛ, mede no mafɛm AWURADE; ne nna a ɔbɛtena aseɛ nyinaa mede no mama AWURADE. Na ɔsɔree AWURADE wɔ hɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
